scope.hypotheses: the record's convention L = [[1,1],[0,1]], R = [[1,0],[1,1]]; symmetries are integer matrices conjugating LR to itself or its inverse, searched in full to entries 12 and in the two solution families to 300; the orientation sign of a symmetry is det X times its exponent; the hand question itself (which count of placements applies) is not decided

claim_one_line: THE LINE'S LAST BIT GOES WITH THE HAND (decision 4; P-718's Q1): the extension condition gives what the ground already gives, order 5 and the eigenline (B1867, P-718), and no history can separate the line's twins (an identity, B1872); every symmetry of the golden bundle (104 found, eight classes modulo LR, four reversing the orientation, as SnapPy's D4) keeps the eigenline mod 5 and acts on it by +-1 when it keeps the orientation and by +-2 when it reverses it, so the twins are exchanged exactly by the mirrors and the four placements (hand, twin) are two classes. No input leaves; decision 4 sits with decision 1. 0 of 19.
